archetype: LUXURY & TACTICAL GLASS (Music Tech Staff Operations)
environment: Vanilla JS Single-Page Web App (HTML5, Tailwind CDN, Plain CSS / JS, Lucide icons)

scale.stat_number: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold font-mono tracking-wider (Doto font)
scale.caption: text-xs font-medium text-white/50 tracking-wide uppercase

desktop_1400x850.container: fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl animate-fade-in
desktop_1400x850.panel: w-full max-w-[1400px] h-[850px] max-h-[92vh] rounded-3xl border border-white/10 bg-[#120b22]/90 backdrop-blur-2xl shadow-[0_25px_60px_-15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] flex flex-col overflow-hidden
desktop_1400x850.top_header: h-16 px-6 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 bg-white/5
desktop_1400x850.left_nav_rail: w-64 border-r border-white/10 p-4 flex flex-col gap-2 shrink-0 bg-black/20
desktop_1400x850.center_main_content: flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 space-y-6 scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-white/10
desktop_1400x850.right_detail_pane: w-[380px] border-l border-white/10 p-6 overflow-y-auto shrink-0 bg-black/30 transition-all duration-300 transform translate-x-0

mobile_390x844.container: fixed inset-0 z-50 flex flex-col bg-[#0a0612] h-[100dvh] w-full overflow-hidden animate-slide-up
mobile_390x844.header: h-14 px-4 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 bg-[#140e22]
mobile_390x844.nav_tabs: flex overflow-x-auto gap-2 px-4 py-2 border-b border-white/10 no-scrollbar shrink-0 bg-black/40
mobile_390x844.detail_pane_mobile: fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-[#0a0612] flex flex-col transition-transform duration-300

header_controls.title: Staff Control Center
header_controls.search_input: Quick search (@username or display name) with shortcut tag 'Ctrl+K'
header_controls.close_button: Icon button (X) to dismiss dashboard overlay

overview_section.stat_tiles_grid: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3 sm:gap-4
overview_section.activity_sparkline: 7-day activity bar chart with hover tooltips showing daily moderation volume
overview_section.recent_activity_preview: Mini activity feed showing the 5 most recent staff actions

activity_log.filter_bar: Flex row with horizontally scrollable chip filters: Action Types (All, Bans, Mutes, Edits, Badges, Roles, Deletes), Staff Filter Dropdown, Time Range (Today, 7d, 30d, All), Username Search Input
activity_log.grouped_rows: Activity items grouped by Day (Today, Yesterday, Oct 12, etc.) with timestamp, staff actor avatar, target user, action badge, and reason string

people_lists.user_row: Card item with Avatar, Display Name, Username, Badges, Status Sub-line ('Banned until Oct 12 · Spam'), and Quick Action Buttons ('Lift Ban', 'Unmute', 'Edit Role', 'View Profile')

per_person_moderation_sheet.overlay_style: Desktop: Centered glass modal (w-[560px]). Mobile: Touch-draggable bottom sheet sliding from bottom
per_person_moderation_sheet.user_hero_header: Avatar (64px), Display Name, Username (@handle), Role Badge, Status Pills (Suspended/Muted/Verified)
per_person_moderation_sheet.current_status_card: Summary box displaying active penalties or verified status with expiration timer
per_person_moderation_sheet.quick_action_grid: 6 interactive action tiles: [Ban User], [Mute User], [Edit Profile], [Badges & Verified], [Manage Role], [Delete Account]

focused_action_panels.ban_panel: Duration chips (1 Hour, 1 Day, 3 Days, 1 Week, 30 Days, Permanent, Pick Date), Reason text input, 'Ban User' / 'Update Ban' / 'Lift Ban' primary actions
focused_action_panels.mute_panel: Duration chips (1 Hour, 1 Day, 3 Days, 1 Week, 30 Days, Permanent, Pick Date), Reason text input, 'Mute User' / 'Lift Mute' actions
focused_action_panels.profile_edit_panel: Inputs for Display Name, Username, Bio, Quick action buttons: [Clear Bio], [Remove Photo], [Remove Banner]
focused_action_panels.badges_role_panel: Verified toggle switch, linked Icon Page select, Role selector radio group (Member, Moderator, Admin)
focused_action_panels.delete_panel: Danger zone warning box, 'Type username to confirm' input, 'Permanently Delete Account' red button

per_person_moderation_sheet.permission_lock_notice: Notice banner for non-admin moderators: 'Only Admins can perform ban/role actions' with lock icon
per_person_moderation_sheet.sticky_footer: Action bar with 'Cancel / Close' and 'Apply Moderation Action' CTA with confirmation dialog state

motion_and_interactions.tab_switch: smooth crossfade fade-in with 4px vertical slide
motion_and_interactions.chip_active_state: scale(0.97) on active press, border highlight glow

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.dark_glass_aesthetics: Maintain high contrast dark glass panels with white/10 borders, backdrop blur, and vivid neon accent highlights.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography_rules: Use Space Grotesk for headings, Manrope for clean legible body/UI, and Doto font strictly for numeric stat counters.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.plain_html_js: Ensure all UI elements are fully implementable using plain HTML DOM elements, Tailwind CSS classes, and vanilla JavaScript event handlers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: Every interactive button, input, tab, card, and modal MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.
